summary.text: Dean Hunter is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 69 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Republican incumbent David Ray.
A veterinarian, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has accepted no campaign donations and supports campaign finance reform.

paragraphs.text: Dean Hunter earned a high school diploma from Madison County High School and additional education from the University of Georgia College of Veterinary Medicine in 1987.
His career experience includes working as a veterinarian.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hunter said that although he is running as a Democrat, his more liberal positions are rooted in conservative values.
He cited school meals, universal Medicare, early education investment and firearm safety among his positions.
He also said he had not taken money from anyone during the campaign and called for campaign finance reform.
